title: OFSMMA
tagline: FSMMA Frame converted to OpenFrames standard making it available on XMTP
description: The FSMMA Frame project, now adapted to the OpenFrames standard and integrated with XMTP, is a technical advancement in decentralized communication. This adaptation allows the frame to be used across different platforms that support XMTP, offering encrypted, private messaging capabilities. By making these frames compatible with the OpenFrames standard, we're enhancing the way brands can interact with their audience, ensuring a more secure and versatile approach to engagement in the Web3 ecosystem.
how_its_made: The FSMMA Frame project combines Astro for frontend development and Go 1.22 for the backend, creating a robust and scalable solution. Astro's static site generation capabilities ensure fast, efficient loading times and SEO-friendly pages, while Go's performance and simplicity support a reliable backend service. Together, these technologies underpin the conversion of FSMMA Frames to the OpenFrames standard, further facilitated by XMTP for secure, decentralized communication. This project also incorporates hacky, innovative solutions, such as custom integrations for seamless compatibility across decentralized platforms, showcasing our technical versatility and creative problem-solving.
